notes: Scanned a card twice? Combine the two scans into one grade, from Grade a card or from the list after grading a folder
A scan on black and one on white: each edge now comes from the scan that shows it best
Scanners that save each scan as TIFF, PNG and JPG: each card is graded once, from the best copy
A scan your scanner is still saving is tried again instead of failing
Centering: drag any side to the card's frame, even one it couldn't measure
